title: Seven Fat Cows, Seven Thin Cows, and a Plan That Saved a Country

meta.name: v5_y12_10_the-kings-dream
meta.title: Seven Fat Cows, Seven Thin Cows, and a Plan That Saved a Country

lines.text: Seven fat cows. Seven thin cows. A whole country at stake.
A king has a dream no adviser can explain.
Then a freed prisoner remembers Yūsuf.
Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry.

quran.ar: إِنِّیۤ أَرَىٰ سَبۡعَ بَقَرَ ٰ⁠تࣲ سِمَانࣲ یَأۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافࣱ وَسَبۡعَ سُنۢبُلَـٰتٍ خُضۡرࣲ وَأُخَرَ یَابِسَـٰتࣲۖ

lines.text: You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat.

quran.ar: تَزۡرَعُونَ سَبۡعَ سِنِینَ دَأَبࣰا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمۡ فَذَرُوهُ فِی سُنۢبُلِهِۦۤ إِلَّا قَلِیلࣰا مِّمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ

lines.text: Good answers include a next step.
Solve the problem, not just the puzzle.
